articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows below $59,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
articles.snippet: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
articles.snippet: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.

articles.title: Anthropic shares may fall 5% at Friday’s open, crypto futures suggest
articles.snippet: About $1.7 billion traded through a Hyperliquid contract on the AI company’s shares in 24 hours, and the biggest position heading into Friday’s Nasdaq open is a $30 million short.

articles.title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
articles.snippet: PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September, wiping out most of its debt, and ended the month with about $650,000 in cash and a going-concern warning.

articles.title: Big money bought a net $4 billion of bitcoin funds in Q3, ending 9 months of selling
articles.snippet: Wall Street piled into Bitcoin funds in the third quarter, ending a three-quarter selling streak, according to Galaxy Research. But the buying has given way to renewed selling this quarter.
